correctness.rationale: After specializing the golden-ratio coefficient phi to 3 modulo the ramified prime 5, F=-(X²+Y²)(Y²+Z²)(Z²+X²)-3(X²+Y²+Z²-W²)²W² up to a unit. Independent Gröbner checks on all four projective affine charts show the Jacobian ideal contains each local t^5-t, so no geometric singularities outside F5 and the singular coordinate ring is reduced. Independent exhaustive F5 chart counts [75,13,3,0] for points and 65 singular nodes with nonzero Hessians; independent direct F25 arithmetic (theta²=2) counts [1635,13,3,0] (1651 total). The 65 split A1 exceptional conics add 65q points, giving Y(F5)=416 and Y(F25)=3276. Adjunction/K resolution gives K²=24, chi=11, c2=108, b1=b3=0, b2=106; F25 count saturates 1+25²+106*25, forcing Frobenius squares=25. Trace 390 at F5 gives multiplicities +5=92,-5=14 and exact all-extension zeta. Finite counts are exhaustive only over F5/F25; cohomological rigidity supplies the infinite statement. No claim about Picard rank or other integral models.

The 1996 original full paper was not read, and unindexed characteristic-five computations remain historical priority risks.
